tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Search MyPetDance's AI trend video templates by meme name, alias or keyword. Each result has the creation page link, how many photos to upload, lengths and credit prices. Leave query empty to list the newest templates.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get full details of one template by its slug (e.g. "cat-riding-surron-ai"), id or page URL, including guide pages.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get MyPetDance's credit packs and prices in US dollars.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_template · Public sink: search_templates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_template · Public sink: search_templates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
